script: if(window.__sniffBridgeInited!==true){function sniffResource(){var list=document.querySelectorAll('#cata_video_list url=aWrapper.href;var img=item.querySelector('img.video_thumbs');var title=aWrapper.getAttribute('title').trim();var descEl=item.querySelector('.video_detail_info.desc');var sniffEpisode(){var menuList=document.querySelectorAll('ul.nav-pills button.nav-link');var sourceList=document.querySelectorAll('div.tab-content div.tab-pane');if(!sourceList||0==sourceList.length){sendEpisodeList([]);return}var sourceMap={};for(var i=0;i<sourceList.length;i++){var episodeList=sourceList[i].getElementsByTagName('a');if(0==episodeList.length)continue;sourceMap[menuList[i].textContent.replace('VIP','')]=Array.from(episodeList).map(item=>({name:item.textContent,url:item.href}))}sendSourceMap(sourceMap)}async function sniffPlayUrl(){const iframe=document.querySelector('#iframeForVideo');if(iframe){sendLoadIframe(iframe.getAttribute('src'));return}const video=await waitForElement('video',10,200);if(!video){sniffLog('未找到video元素');sendPlayUrl('');return}const playUrl=video.getAttribute('src');sendPlayUrl(playUrl)}function waitForElement(selector,maxRetry=10,intervalMs=200){return new Promise((resolve)=>{let count=0;function poll(){const el=document.querySelector(selector);if(el){resolve(el);return}count++;if(count>=maxRetry){resolve(null);return}setTimeout(poll,intervalMs)}poll()})}function getId(uri){const url=new URL(uri);const path=url.pathname;const filename=path.split('/').pop();return filename}window.taskSniffResource=function(){sniffLog('开始执行任务：获取资源信息');sniffResource();sniffLog('任务执行完成：获取资源信息')};window.taskSniffEpisode=function(){sniffLog('开始执行任务：获取分集列表');sniffEpisode();sniffLog('任务执行完成：获取分集列表')};window.taskSniffPlayUrl=function(){sniffLog('开始执行任务：嗅探播放地址');sniffPlayUrl();sniffLog('任务执行完成：嗅探播放地址')};function sendToFlutter(msg){window.FlutterBridge&&window.FlutterBridge.postMessage(JSON.stringify(msg))}function sniffLog(text){sendToFlutter({msgType:'log',payload:String(text)})}function
